remarks: Here is your opportunity to rent this well-maintained Raised Ranch, ideally situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. The bright Living Room flows seamlessly into the Dining Room, French doors open to a four-season sunroom. Updated Kitchen features SS appliances, 3 bedrooms on the main level and full renovated bath with tub. The finished lower level offers a large family room or flexible living space with a full walkout to the back yard and patio. Plus a second full bath with a renovated shower stall. New Pella windows and a sliding glass door add to the home's comfort and efficiency. Additional features include a one-car attached garage, and a spacious, fully fenced backyard with plenty of green space. Landscaping is included in the rent. Pets allowed. Some photos are from prior to tenants tenancy. Fridge in kitchen is 6/months old and is now a SS refrigerator.
